ops.entry: WHEN specifying a must-fix against a defect class DO hand down every state, predicate leg and representation the decision consumes, reading how the producer normalizes each shape first, and require a discriminating mutant per leg — a defaulted shape must pass, and an unwitnessed leg's mutant can fail open.
ops.why: My c1 must_fix prescribed refusing both null and omitted features; the ruler found the producer normalizes omitted to a legitimate default that must pass, so my fixture spec would have forced a regression. The ruled check then had three legs but fixtures only for two; the isinstance leg's mutant survived c2 and fails open. Sharpens P-12 (states/representation) with legs and producer normalization; same length class.

originals.original: WHEN ruling a must-fix against a defect class DO hand down every state the decision consumes and the representation the clause names, requiring a discriminating mutant per state and per representation (a newline-normalizing writer for bytes) — instance-scoped or normalized remedies close one member per round, and rounds are budgeted.
